about.title: About Enderas
about.subtitle: Auction Management System
about.description: Enderas is a comprehensive auction management system designed to streamline the auction process for organizations and individuals in Ethiopia. It provides end-to-end management of assets, evaluations, bids, payments, and winners with full transparency and audit trails.
about.feature1: Full auction lifecycle management from creation to winner selection
about.feature3: Real-time bid management with draft support
about.feature4: Secure payment processing with CPO integration
about.feature5: Public tracking portal for auction transparency
